description: Compare a tokenized asset's on-chain price against the price of the security it tracks, and report the gap in basis points. A persistent premium or discount is the clearest sign that the mint and redeem path is not clearing, whether because of venue friction, market hours, or issuer limits.

asset.description: Registry symbol such as TSLAx, or any Solana mint address.

name: get_reference_premium
title: Compare token price to its reference
